['DAW SE '].company_description: DAW SE is a company that has been developing, producing, and selling innovative coating systems since 1895. It is an independent family company in its fifth generation. Additionally, it offers a range of digital audio workstations (DAWs) for music production, including Ableton Live.

['Dyckerhoff GmbH '].company_description: Dyckerhoff GmbH is a company involved in the production and supply of cement and concrete. It operates in the construction materials industry and provides products for various construction projects, including supplying cement and concrete for infrastructure projects such as the U 81 light rail line in Düsseldorf.
